title: Cost-Aware Model Router with Fallback
signature: def route_requests(requests, models, tiers, call) -> dict
hints: Filter first: quality, p95 latency and context window all come from the request's tier and size. Fallbacks are drawn only from this eligible list.
Rank by the estimated cost of this request, input_tokens * input price + max_output_tokens * output price, not by either price alone.
A 400 means the request itself is bad: stop. A 429, 5xx or timeout means try the next model. A model that answered 429 is skipped for the rest of the batch.
Bill the successful call with the output tokens it actually used, and bill failed attempts nothing.
